label: rejected
reviewer: blind fresh agent (renders + close-ups + gate report + rubric only)

evidence.V1: Front reads clearly as a round shield (disc, gold rim, boss), but the silhouette render is a featureless ellipse with no outline break from the boss, rim or rivets; at 64 px the 3/4 view could be any disc. Only the edge-on top view shows the boss and handle.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big disc and gold rim, medium steel boss with a stepped flange, small rivet ring and plank fan. They read as separate levels in the front and 3/4 views.
evidence.V3: Chunky rim and dome boss are stylised, but the face is a thin flat plate and the 16 rivets are undersized dots that turn to noise at distance. Only partly exaggerated.
evidence.V4: The rim chamfer and boss flange catch a clean highlight. The rivets are hard-faceted octagons with no bevel, and the rim's outer edge shows straight polygon segments in close_rim_studio, so the treatment is inconsistent.
evidence.V5: The flat close-ups show the plank colour boundaries kinked and bent (for example the light wedge upper-left of the boss in boss_flat, and the bent wedge edge in rim_flat), with uneven wedge widths. Vertex-colour seams follow an irregular triangulation instead of straight radial lines. Rivet faceting is also visible.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: gold rim accent, steel greys on the boss and rivets, one hue (teal) in light and dark values, and a dark ink handle. Value contrast is strong, and the crimson and shadow colourways keep the same structure.
evidence.V7: 2160 tris against a weapon target of 2500 (ceiling 4000). Under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, SmoothPlastic, chamfers present. Minor mismatches: the plank hue shows only 2 values (the kit asks for 3), the rivets are faceted rather than smooth-shaded, and the rivets sit toward the rim's inner edge instead of centred on the band.
evidence.V9: Studio line is correct: origin at the handle/hand point, CollisionFidelity Box, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white for vertex colours, SmoothPlastic. A1-A18 all pass; symmetry error X/Z is 0.0; the rivets and handle are seated.

artifacts: Plank vertex-colour boundaries are kinked/zig-zag and wedge widths are uneven on the shield face (close_boss_flat, close_rim_flat), because the face triangulation does not match the radial plank edges
Rivets are visibly faceted 8-sided nubs with flat facets and no bevel (close_rim_studio)
Rim outer edge shows straight polygon segments in close-up (close_rim_studio)
top_fixes: Rebuild the face topology with straight radial edge loops matched to the plank count (and equal angular spacing), so the vertex-colour plank seams are straight and wedge widths are even
Give the silhouette a break: raise the boss dome higher, and/or notch or scallop the rim or enlarge the rivets so they bump the outline; the current silhouette is a plain ellipse
Make the rivets larger, with 12+ sides or a smooth-shaded dome and a small chamfer, centred on the rim band rather than hugging its inner edge
Spend the ~340 spare tris on more rim segments so the outer edge reads round in close-up
Add a third teal value (e.g. a mid tone or a thin plank-edge line) to meet the kit's one-hue-in-3-values rule
